nodes.statement: The public sale route shall render listing cards containing title, price, area and location when those values are supplied.
preconditions: The public entry page is available.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the sampled sale page, at least one card displays title, price, area and location.

nodes.statement: The public rental route shall render rental listing cards.
preconditions: The public entry page is available.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the rental route, rental cards and displayed rental prices are visible.

nodes.statement: Submitting the sampled keyword shall navigate to a results state with the keyword encoded in q.
preconditions: The public entry page is available.
acceptanceCriteria: Given Quận 1 entered, when Tìm kiếm is clicked, URL q decodes to Quận 1 and result cards are rendered.

nodes.statement: The listing page shall expose price, area and room filter entry controls.
preconditions: The public entry page is available.
acceptanceCriteria: Given sale results, Khoảng giá, Diện tích and Phòng ngủ controls are visible.

nodes.statement: The sampled property detail shall display listing identifier, price, area and description.
preconditions: The public entry page is available.
acceptanceCriteria: Given listing 1dk006, identifier, Mức giá, Diện tích and Mô tả chi tiết are displayed.

nodes.statement: Selecting a listing for comparison shall show that item in the comparison tray.
preconditions: The public entry page is available.
acceptanceCriteria: Given no selected items, clicking comparison on one card displays So sánh tin đăng and 1/2.

nodes.statement: Selecting another listing shall show two items in the comparison tray.
preconditions: The public entry page is available.
acceptanceCriteria: Given one selected item, selecting another displays 2/2 and two titles in the tray.

nodes.statement: The map entry shall open a map/list shell containing a listing panel.
preconditions: The public entry page is available.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the observed map route, Danh sách, Bản đồ and listing cards are visible; tile rendering is outside this verified criterion.

nodes.statement: The public project catalog shall show project names, locations and displayed starting prices.
preconditions: The public entry page is available.
acceptanceCriteria: Given project catalog, at least one sampled project shows name, location and Giá từ.

nodes.statement: The Wiki BĐS catalog shall display article titles, excerpts and dates.
preconditions: The public entry page is available.
acceptanceCriteria: Given Wiki BĐS, sampled article title, excerpt and date are visible.

nodes.statement: The public login page shall expose phone/password inputs and a Google sign-in entry.
preconditions: The public entry page is available.
acceptanceCriteria: Given login route, Số điện thoại, Mật khẩu and Tiếp tục với Google are visible; successful authentication remains unverified.

nodes.statement: Opening the posting route without authentication shall redirect this visitor to login preserving the posting callback.
preconditions: The public entry page is available.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a fresh unauthenticated context, opening /dang-tin ends at login with callbackUrl decoding to /dang-tin.

nodes.statement: The homepage shall expose an AI search entry label.
preconditions: The public entry page is available.
acceptanceCriteria: Given homepage, Tìm với AI is visible; no result-quality claim follows.
